content.title:
A daily IPMAT routine
*that actually lasts.*
content.subtitle: Small and steady beats long and rare. Five parts of a simple study day.

steps.title: Warm up with mental maths
steps.detail: Ten minutes of squares, percentages and fractions before anything else.

steps.title: One Quant topic, deep
steps.detail: Learn or revise one topic and solve 20 to 25 questions on it.

steps.title: One reading block
steps.detail: Read one long article and note three new words with their meanings.

steps.title: Mixed practice, timed
steps.detail: Fifteen mixed questions under time, Quant and Verbal together.

steps.title: Redo your mistakes
steps.detail: End the day by redoing what you got wrong. That is where marks come from.

content.saveLine: Send it to your study partner.
